Question: Is watching a bright screen (computer/TV) in the dark damaging to your eyes?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine your eyes are like little cameras. When you watch a bright screen in the dark, it’s a bit like shining a flashlight right into your camera. It can make your eyes work extra hard to see, and that can make them feel tired or even give you a little headache. But it won’t make your eyes broken or hurt them forever—just like how looking at the sun for a second doesn’t make you blind forever.

But it’s not good to do it for a long time. It’s better to have some light in the room when you look at a bright screen. That way, your eyes don’t have to work so hard, and you feel more comfy!
